name: Mrk 950, host of iPTF16fnl (Hubble)
blurb: Mrk 950, a post-starburst galaxy that hosted the tidal disruption event iPTF16fnl, seen by Hubble.
label: iptf16fnl-hubble
story: We see this galaxy nearly edge-on. In 2016 a star that strayed too close to its central black hole was torn apart by tidal forces, a flare astronomers named iPTF16fnl.

claims.text: The host galaxy of iPTF16fnl is Markarian 950 (Mrk 950)
iPTF16fnl is a likely tidal disruption event discovered by the iPTF survey
A tidal disruption event is when a star is torn apart by tidal forces (of a black hole)
The host is a post-starburst (E+A) galaxy
Hubble program 17765 surveys tidal disruption event host galaxies and targeted iPTF16fnl
